question: Does the causal elapsed server time since the immediately previous admitted birth of the same strategy materially and broadly separate the current lifecycle's stressed return and stop-loss incidence enough to justify exactly one later strategy-specific cadence-treatment question that preserves every portfolio opportunity?

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_gap_feasibility.scope: Birth times and same-strategy ordering only; no close value, stressed return, stop result or gap-outcome association was inspected.
pre_outcome_gap_feasibility.pressure_density_note: Pressure has SHORT/LONG tail size at least eight in P1, P3 and P4; P2 tail size seven is excluded from period-breadth counts without changing the field.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return lifecycle and supplies positive planned_risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: PASSIVE_PLACE stores positive planned risk; only PASSIVE_FILL begins an admitted Passive lifecycle.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends one active lifecycle; value_b is native stressed net USD and detail reason=DEAL_REASON_SL marks a stop exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.gap_field: For every lifecycle except the first in each strategy-period stream, elapsed server hours from the immediately previous admitted birth of that same strategy to the current birth. Previous close time and previous outcome are not used.
fixed_reconstruction.continuous_view: Pooled Spearman correlation between raw positive gap hours and current stressed_r, with average ranks for ties.
fixed_reconstruction.tail_view: Within each strategy-period sort by gap hours ascending, then current birth time and fixed source order. SHORT is the first floor(n/3), LONG the last floor(n/3); the middle is descriptive-excluded and ties retain this deterministic order.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Every admitted lifecycle has one positive planned risk and exactly one CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE; no strategy overlaps itself.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles: RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Stressed net sums exactly to 407.0477 USD and stop exits exactly to 206.

Exclude exactly 24 first strategy-period births, form exactly 2,209 causal pairs and reproduce pooled pair counts Cross 801, Passive 590, Pressure 114, RC16 268, RC4 202 and Return 234 with every gap strictly positive.

density: At least 30 SHORT and 30 LONG tail observations pooled.
Both tails have at least eight observations in at least three periods.
At least ten distinct positive gap-hour values pooled.
continuous_effect: Absolute pooled Spearman correlation between gap hours and stressed_r is at least 0.20.
At least three eligible periods share the pooled correlation sign.
tail_economic_effect: Absolute pooled LONG-minus-SHORT mean stressed_r is at least 0.10R.
At least three eligible periods share the pooled tail-return sign.
stop_coherence: Absolute pooled LONG-minus-SHORT stop-rate difference is at least 0.05.
At least three eligible periods share the pooled stop-rate sign.
Tail return and stop effects are economically coherent: lower LONG return requires higher LONG stop incidence, or higher LONG return requires lower LONG stop incidence.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger absolute pooled tail-return difference, then larger absolute Spearman, then larger absolute stop-rate difference, then more same-sign eligible periods, then more pairs, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later strategy-specific cadence-treatment question. Unit 035 selects no exact hour threshold, suppression, delay, size ratio, stop, hold, management, EA or Live candidate. Any later question must keep every frozen opportunity eligible at no less than base minimum lot and compare the complete six-strategy shared portfolio.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no interbirth-gap treatment question. Do not rescue with log transforms, calendar/trading-day gaps, previous close, previous outcome, streak, weekday, session, direction, signal, incumbent, period exception or alternate quantile.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading any gap-conditioned close outcome.
Run exactly one aggregation over the six frozen files.
Do not inspect a transformed gap field, threshold or subgroup inside Unit 035.
Do not run MT5, add MQL, create a reusable analysis CLI or touch Live.
Do not reopen or repair Units 032 through 034.
